about: A Python + Playwright tool that drives Microsoft Edge through a Windchill-based PLM “Search Part To AML” approval workflow, and stops before Submit so a person always makes the final check.

steps.title: Find the part
steps.body: Searches the part and starts the approval workflow.

steps.title: Fill everything in
steps.body: Assigns the project, uploads or links the approval documents and fills the approval form.

steps.title: Add the reviewer
steps.body: Adds the reviewer and verifies every field.

steps.title: You press Submit
steps.body: It stops before Submit, so the final check is always human.

features.title: Four ready launchers
features.body: Final or conditional approval, customer-assigned or not: one double-click each.

features.title: Your site, your config
features.body: Portal URL, selectors and default reviewer live in a git-ignored config file.

features.title: Installs itself
features.body: On Windows with Edge and Python 3, the launchers install Playwright on first run.
